params.name: returnEntity
params.description: If true, includes the entity in the response body.

params.name: with

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

params.name: senderId
params.description: Unique identifier of the user who sent the email.

params.name: senderId:in
params.description: Unique identifier of the user who sent the email. Search for results that match any of the specified values of this parameter. (Recommended request size <= 100)

params.name: isRecipient
params.description: Filter results to include only emails where the current user is a recipient.

params.name: read
params.description: Filter results based on whether the email has been read by the current user.

params.name: date
params.description: Filter results by the email creation date.

params.name: date:gt
params.description: Filter emails created after the specified date.

params.name: date:gte
params.description: Filter emails created on or after the specified date.

params.name: date:lt
params.description: Filter emails created before the specified date.

params.name: date:lte
params.description: Filter emails created on or before the specified date.

params.name: modified_date
params.description: Filter emails by the last modified date of the email.

params.name: modified_date:gt
params.description: Filter emails modified after the specified date.

params.name: modified_date:gte
params.description: Filter emails modified on or after the specified date.

params.name: modified_date:lt
params.description: Filter emails modified before the specified date.

params.name: modified_date:lte
params.description: Filter emails modified on or before the specified date.

params.name: deleted
params.description: Indicates whether the email has been deleted.

params.name: emailPackageId
params.description: Filter results by the unique identifier of the email package.

params.name: emailPackageId:in
params.description: Filter results by email package identifiers. Matches any of the specified values.

params.name: templateId
params.description: Filter results by the unique identifier of the email template.

params.name: templateId:in
params.description: Filter results by email template identifiers. Matches any of the specified values.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter results by email status. Accepts a comma-separated list of values.
`sent` – Successfully delivered to recipients.
`draft` – Saved but not yet sent.
`queued` – Waiting to be sent.
`error` – Failed to send.
`self_send` – Sent only to the sender (self-copy only).
`pending_review` – Awaiting DLP or admin approval.
`denied` – Rejected by a DLP or admin policy.

params.name: isPreview
params.description: Filter results to include only preview emails if set to true.

params.name: isUserSent
params.description: Filter results to include only emails sent by the user if set to true.

params.name: bucket
params.description:
Filter results to emails in the specified mailbox bucket.
`inbox` – Received emails.
`draft` – Unsent draft emails.
`outgoing` – Emails queued or in progress.
`sent` – Successfully sent emails.
`trash` – Deleted emails.

params.name: returnCustomWebForm
params.description: Includes emails with custom web forms in the results.

params.name: customWebFormOnly
params.description: Filter results to only include emails with custom web forms.

params.name: trackingOnly
params.description: Filter results to only include emails with tracking access.

params.name: approvalRequestOnly
params.description: Filter results to only include emails with approval requests.

params.name: webFormId
params.description: Filter results by unique identifier of the email web form.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Sort order for the results. Default is `id:asc`.
Allowed values: `id:asc`, `id:desc`, `date:asc`, `date:desc`, `status:asc`, `status:desc`.

params.name: sharedMailboxId
params.description: Unique identifier of the shared mailbox. Filters results to emails belonging to the shared mailbox.

params.name: limit
params.description: Range limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Range offset.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Gets a list of messages from the current user's mailbox folders: Inbox, Sent & Tracked, Drafts, Trash, and Outbox. Each result includes the email ID, sent date, and send status.
### Precondition:
  None.
### Response:
  Returns the list of messages across the user's mail folders.
### Sorting:
  Sort string syntax `FIELD_NAME:ORDER`.

  ORDER can be `asc` or `desc`.
### Sorting options:
  | FIELD_NAME | Description              |
  |------------|--------------------------|
  |

### Description:
  Using email IDs, permanently deletes messages from the current user's Inbox and Sent folders. Depending on the system retention policy, messages may be recoverable until they are permanently purged by the system.
### Preconditions:

### Response:

### Description:
  Using an email ID, withdraws the specified file attachments from a sent message.
### Notes:
  - The message itself is not withdrawn. Only the links to its file attachments are deactivated, making the files inaccessible to the original recipients. The files remain in the system until they expire.
  - If a recipient forwarded the message before it was withdrawn, attachment links remain active for those recipients until the files expire.
